A0150.title: OTA Channel Encryption and Integrity Protection
A0150.definition: Using encryption protocols such as TLS to protect the transmission process of OTA updates and prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.
A0150.description: Transport layer protection: enforce HTTPS/TLS communication; certificate pinning to prevent MITM; integrity checksum; segmented transfer verification; resume transfer protection; server identity authentication.
A0150.limitation: Requires reliable network and proper certificate management, with poor support on legacy devices. Certificate pinning can be bypassed by packet capture tools and hooking frameworks. An attacker can circumvent TLS and integrity verification by reverse engineering the client to tamper with validation logic or forge root certificates, posing risks of compromise and false positives on legacy firmware.
keywords: OTA Channel Encryption and Integrity Protection
